rules.alternatives: No CE hours; instead an active license requires nursing employment of at least 140 hours in any 12-month period within the past 6 years. Otherwise reentry: 480 hours of nursing employment in the past 6 years or a Board-approved refresher course, verified by the employer or course evidence.
rules.notes: License expires on the birth date in the second calendar year after issue, then every two years. Renewal requires evidence of employment status. The Board site (sdbon.org) could not be reached; a renewal-requirements rule 20:48:03:01.03 (2026) is cited but its text was not available.
